groups.decision: Separate individual page subscription scope, cloud feature declarations, fpt-rendered sections and paid-agent eligibility. Free article scope is not paid-agent entitlement; no GHES range is declared.

Personal Allow/Block choices differ from organization/enterprise-inherited policies. About-150-character matching and most-product support are bounded detection, not exhaustive copyright/license review. Allowed or unsupported-Block suggestions may expose match details without granting rights.
Retain GitHub settings versus IDE configuration and each navigation/toggle procedure. A reachable menu or read procedure is not evidence of an applied, propagated or effective policy.
Autonomous research/planning/code changes and optional PR creation are product capabilities, not blanket task authority, approval or acceptance.

Qualify default-enabled claims with paid eligibility, explicit disablement and Enterprise Managed User repository exclusions. Verify No/All/Only selected plus actual selected targets. Personal-owned settings do not supersede organization policy or possible enterprise control.

Third-party coding-agent choices and installed app enablement are independent of effective repository grants. Partners use cloud agent's enabled repository set; reconcile separate organization app policies rather than generalize this personal UI.

Web search has a separate default-disabled policy and Bing information-processing route. Model-hosting privacy claims do not establish Bing policy or terms; verify the effective Enabled/Disabled state.

Preserve April 24, 2026 applicability, individual plans, interactions/context data scope, explicit Disabled opt-out, missing-control account verification and Business/Enterprise DPA protection with customer-authorization caveat. Verify applicable plan, agreement and setting separately; absence of UI is not PASS.

cross_source_reconciliation.privacy_decision: Provider no-training/ZDR promises, GitHub training use, individual opt-out, DPA customer authorization, default agent access and Bing routes are independently assessed dimensions. The account-policy fragment explicitly qualifies enterprise data-training protection with customer authorization; retain that qualification when reconciling shorter no-training statements.
cross_source_reconciliation.rights_decision: Public-code filtering and match details do not establish output licensing; no publication permission follows from an allowed suggestion.
cross_source_reconciliation.authority_decision: Documented default agent availability does not override user task scope, actual role permissions, enterprise policy, paid entitlement, native-change approvals or repository exclusions.

proposed_review_procedure.default: Read-only effective-policy collection; no personal or administrator setting changes from ingestion.
proposed_review_procedure.missing_permission_or_control: UNVERIFIED with reason and accountable review, never PASS.
proposed_review_procedure.native_remediation: Only scoped approval plus reviewed plan/diff/apply/verify and recovery evidence; UI procedure is not a binding receipt.

remaining_work: Review linked privacy, account-plan and matching-code content independently.
Reconcile full organization/enterprise policy article and its separate agent-app controls.
Review actual versioned rendered pages and dependencies.
Audit omissions/atomicity, canonical applicability and templates before policy adoption.
Collect effective authorized target settings and behavior receipts only within explicit native approval.
